title: Native krn ship in Product; deliver stops calling the legacy install
body: From the t-dsxc125 audit (.krn/runs/lead/dsxc125/ship-inventory.md): Product delivery shells out to `krn ship` on PATH, which is the legacy GLOBAL install (release 1eb17b8, not the fixed b41faae). The 2026-11-06 session lost ~3 h to it (orphaned Jenkins krn/gate check, foreign-file collision on install, PATH shim). Port ship into Product as `src/deliver/ship.ts` with the same CLI and JSON contract and make deliver invoke `<main checkout>/bin/krn ship`, so the merge authority is merged code and no host install sits on the delivery path.
